description: Whether one site can be installed as an app: visitors add it to their phone's home screen or install it on their computer, with the site's logo, a launch screen and a page shown when they are offline. Answers on, opens (how the installed site opens, when on), every way it can open with its meaning, and whether the person may change it. Changing it is set_install_as_app.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.
